name: Tauer (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and green in the proportions 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tauer (a yellow aurochs on green).
history: The arms, designed by the heraldist Uwe Reipert, were approved on 9 May 2012; the flag carries them on a green-yellow-green field.

features.role: Tauer arms — yellow aurochs on green
